title: Sufficiently divisible twists pull back to powers of the line module
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $Z$ a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $M$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $\psi:A\to\Gamma_*(Z,M)=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\Gamma(Z,M^{\otimes n})$ a homomorphism of graded rings [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Suppose the nonvanishing opens $Z_{\psi(a)}$, for homogeneous $a\in A$ of positive degree, cover $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Let $r:Z\to P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj] be the canonical morphism, characterized by $r^{-1}D_+(a)=Z_{\psi(a)}$ and the local ring maps $A_{(a)}\to\Gamma(Z_{\psi(a)},\mathcal O_Z)$, $b/a^n\mapsto\psi(b)/\psi(a)^n$ for $b\in A_{n\deg(a)}$. Write $\mathcal O_P(m)=\widetilde{A(m)}$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. There exists $d\geq1$ such that for every $k\geq1$ there is a canonical isomorphism $r^*\mathcal O_P(dk)\simeq M^{\otimes dk}$ [def-pc-module-pullback] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

proof.text: Apply the canonical generation-locus construction to the graded map ψ. The positive-degree nonvanishing opens cover Z by hypothesis, so U(ψ)=Z; the resulting canonical morphism is the stated r, characterized on every basic open D_+(a) by r^{-1}D_+(a)=Z_{ψ(a)} and by the displayed localized ring map.

proof.text: If Z is empty, take d=1; then every sheaf-generation assertion and the final isomorphism on Z are vacuous. Otherwise, quasi-compactness gives a finite nonempty family of positive-degree homogeneous elements a_i∈A_{d_i} whose nonvanishing opens Z_{ψ(a_i)} cover Z. Let d be a common positive multiple of the d_i. For each i, ψ(a_i)^{d/d_i} is a section of M^{⊗d} with the same nonvanishing open, so the degree-d sections ψ(A_d) generate M^{⊗d} on all of Z. Raising these generators to the k-th tensor power shows that ψ(A_{dk}) generates M^{⊗dk} for every k≥1.

source.place: Tag 01NK, final assertion after choosing a common positive degree; quasi-compactness gives a finite subcover and powers move all degrees to d

proof.text: Apply the generated-chart comparison node to V=Z and each positive degree dk. Its hypotheses hold by Step 2, and U(ψ)=Z by Step 1. We obtain the canonical isomorphism r^*O_P(dk)≅M^{⊗dk} for every k≥1. The uniqueness clause identifies these maps with the canonical maps induced by ψ, so the assertion is independent of the finite subcover and of the chosen common multiple.
